correctness_reference: SciPy LAPACK gelsd direct weighted SVD on original training rows with explicit rank cutoff

runtime_estimate.bottleneck: Exact held-out absolute errors require all predictions; caching avoids per-combination full-row fitting.
runtime_estimate.final_refits_and_bootstrap: 59 small selected-model refits and 500-resample fixed-prediction cluster intervals; allow an additional 5-15 minutes
runtime_estimate.parallelism: Optional 2-3 independent target workers with one BLAS thread each; no unmeasured speedup assumed
runtime_estimate.timing_basis: Measured full-population three-period OLS pilot; k/genre/target strata include checkpoint writes; catalog/ranking costs scale by candidate count; exact MAE for every candidate
runtime_estimate.uncertainty: Scenario range, not a confidence interval; tiny genre strata, SVD mix, thermal/storage effects and worker contention vary.
